audience: sales teams that track deals, contacts and follow-up tasks in Kommo

useCases.title: Review the sales pipeline by stage
useCases.text: List the lead pipelines with their stages. Then list the leads in a pipeline with their price, stage and owner.

useCases.title: Look up contacts and companies with their deals
useCases.text: List contacts or companies with their names and custom fields, such as email and phone. Open one by id to see its linked leads or companies.

useCases.title: Check open tasks and the notes on a record
useCases.text: List the open follow-up tasks for one user or one linked entity. Read the notes of a lead, contact or company to see its history.

useCases.title: Create a lead or move a deal to a new stage
useCases.text: Create a lead in a pipeline stage. Creating a lead does not check for duplicates. Update a lead to change its name, value, stage or owner.
